description: This file defines a React component called RecommendationGrid which fetches suggested roles based on a persona ID, handles loading and error states, and renders a grid of RoleCard components with accordion behavior. It includes logic for fetching recommendations from APIs, fallback handling, and UI states.

methods.name: RecommendationGrid
methods.description: React functional component that renders a grid of recommended roles based on provided props, manages state and fetches data.
